owner: public_api.py (integration interface). This is the only graph file the interface owns. It decides nothing about language: it maps selector gates, search completeness and reading-level conflict records onto a status word and an abstention flag. public_api.py performs lookup, set intersection and span overlap only.
comment: A status is never a certification of physical truth. 'answered' means one supported, traceable selector value, complete search, and no relevant contradiction; for reading_conflict, the selected requested-role value must be present in every selector-compatible rival. A sibling excluded by query constraints does not veto an answer. Compatible rivals without the asked role remain unresolved. Attribution scope is separate and may be textually definite. Explicit event-polarity and result conflicts remain contradicted.

error.meaning: compile, execute or render raised, or the reading was not usable; see 'error'

unrepresentable.meaning: the question compiled to no executable plan; see plan.unresolved

incomplete_search.meaning: at least one search hop did not explicitly report complete=true with an assembled world; rivals or support may have been truncated; see search.hops

provenance_incomplete.meaning: the selected support or a cited proof/premise/claim cannot be resolved to the supplied reading; see missing_references and sources

nonassertive_scope.meaning: the selector found supported candidate evidence, but its graph scope is quoted_text or interrogative; see decision_evidence and decision_sources

reported_only.meaning: the selector found only attribution-scoped support for an occurrence question; the text does not establish independent occurrence or non-occurrence

gated.meaning: the selector stopped at a gate this policy does not name; see 'gate'

ambiguous_question.meaning: the question marked a required argument more than once or not at all

ambiguous_reading.meaning: surviving readings disagree on a required answer role; see candidates and conflicts

constraints_unmet.meaning: the question's constraints (roles, action) do not all hold of one event in the reading

no_evidence.meaning: no row answers the question; this is 'not found', never 'false'

ambiguous_answer.meaning: more than one supported value survived; every candidate is listed with its own evidence

contradicted.meaning: a contradiction record in the reading touches the answer's own support and the support does not draw on every side of it

competing_readings.meaning: the answer's support comes from a surviving reading that competes with another surviving reading which does not also support the answer

answered.meaning: one supported value, complete searches, no touching conflict; truth beyond the text is not asserted

conflict_detection.contradiction_agreed_when: for kind reading_conflict only: every listed competing reading has selected evidence for the same requested predicate carrying the selected answer value; all other contradiction kinds always conflict
conflict_detection.competing_reading_conflicts_when: a support reading's competes_with names a reading that contributes no support row to the answer
conflict_detection.dropped_readings: reported when their span overlaps a support span; informational only, the core already removed them by a declared dominance rule

answer_scope_metadata.requested_type: Question-requested category only; not a document fact. unspecified imposes no disjointness.
answer_scope_metadata.type_verification: unknown: no entity category proof was evaluated or inferred.
